timestampComparison: PowerShell-deserialized UTC DateTime values compared directly by ticks; no culture-sensitive DateTime reparsing.
limitations: All baseline files are compared by size and exact UTC modification time. SHA256 is recalculated only for the 70 files selected by the baseline; no new full-content hashing is performed. Unhashed files are not cryptographically verified.
This check is read-only for Content and makes no Editor or MCP calls.
